svg.font-family: 'Geist Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

metadata.orrery:spec: # yaml-language-server: $schema=../references/diagram.schema.json title: Modern SaaS web stack subtitle: Next.js on Vercel serves the UI and Cloudflare fronts the API; Neon and Upstash hold the data while Clerk, Stripe and Resend handle auth, payments and email direction: down # Product cards keep the managed services compact. look: card # One port per edge, so the checkout, webhook and email edges fan out of the API without crossing. layout: { spacing: compact, merge: false } legend: solid: Synchronous request dashed: Webhook dotted: Errors and analytics groups: edge: { type: zone, label: Edge } ui: { type: zone, label: Frontend } app: { type: zone, label: Backend } data: { type: zone, label: Data } auth: { type: zone, label: Identity } saas: { type: zone, label: Third-party services } obs: { type: zone, label: Observability } nodes: # The mobile app first, above Cloudflare, so its API calls drop straight into the edge. mobile: { icon: generic:mobile, label: Mobile app, note: iOS and Android } web: { icon: generic:browser, label: Web, note: Browser } cloudflare: { icon: logos:cloudflare-icon, label: Cloudflare, note: CDN and WAF for the API, in: edge } api: { icon: logos:nodejs-icon, label: API service, note: "Node.js, verifies Clerk JWT", in: app } nextjs: { icon: logos:nextjs-icon, label: Next.js app, note: Hosted on Vercel, in: ui } neon: { icon: logos:neon-icon, label: Neon, note: Serverless Postgres, in: data } upstash: { icon: logos:upstash-icon, label: Upstash, note: Redis cache, in: data } stripe: { icon: si:stripe, label: Stripe, note: Payments and billing, in: saas } resend: { icon: logos:resend-icon, label: Resend, note: Transactional email, in: saas } clerk: { icon: logos:clerk-icon, label: Clerk, note: Auth and sessions, in: auth } sentry: { icon: logos:sentry-icon, label: Sentry, note: Error tracking, in: obs } posthog: { icon: logos:posthog-icon, label: PostHog, note: Analytics and replay, in: obs } edges: # app.example.com is DNS-only to Vercel (Vercel advises against stacking a proxy in front of it). - web -> nextjs: app.example.com # The browser and the mobile app call the API through Cloudflare; the Next.js server fetches from it directly. - web, mobile -> cloudflare: API calls - cloudflare -> api: api.example.com - nextjs -> api: server fetch # Clients sign in against Clerk; the API only verifies the token it sends. - web, mobile -> clerk: sign in - api -> neon: SQL - api -> upstash: REST - api -> stripe: checkout - api -> resend: send email # Written in layout order with the arrow flipped, so the webhook does not loop around. - { from: api, to: stripe, arrow: start, line: dashed, label: webhooks via api.example.com } - nextjs ..> sentry: errors # Kept out of the layout, so Observability sits beside the Backend instead of making a fourth row # under it; the line runs straight across into Sentry. - { from: api, to: sentry, line: dotted, constraint: false } - nextjs ..> posthog: events

svg.title: Modern SaaS web stack
svg.desc: Modern SaaS web stack. 12 components in 7 groups. Connections: Web to Next.js app (app.example.com); Web to Cloudflare (API calls); Mobile app to Cloudflare (API calls); Cloudflare to API service (api.example.com); Next.js app to API service (server fetch); Web to Clerk (sign in); Mobile app to Clerk (sign in); API service to Neon (SQL); API service to Upstash (REST); API service to Stripe (checkout); API service to Resend (send email); API service to Stripe (webhooks via api.example.com); Next.js app to Sentry (errors); API service to Sentry; Next.js app to PostHog (events).

text.tspan: Next.js on Vercel serves the UI and Cloudflare fronts the API; Neon and Upstash hold the data while Clerk, Stripe and Resend handle auth, payments and email
CDN and WAF for the API
